output_list.criticism: The function WMCToken has a potential integer overflow vulnerability due to the use of the uint256 type for the initialSupply parameter. This can lead to an overflow if the initialSupply value is too large. The vulnerability is rated as 7 out of 9 for correctness, 7 out of 9 for severity, and 7 out of 9 for profitability.
